# brig image push

Copy a container image from the host's Podman into a VM

## Synopsis

```text
brig image push [NAME] IMAGE
```

## Description

Copy a container image from the host's Podman storage into the VM's, where
OpenShell sandboxes can use it, e.g. with openshell sandbox create --from.
OpenShell cannot build images itself, so build them on the host. Without
NAME, the VM is the one that [`brig use`](brig-use.md) selected.

## Examples

```sh
podman build -t localhost/my-agent:latest .
brig image push dev localhost/my-agent:latest
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-o, --output format` | output format: table or json (default `table`) |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
